sources.title: HiKorea main
sources.evidence: Official Korean e-government banner present. Menus include 정보광장 > 비자내비게이터(맞춤형 체류가이드), 체류자격별 안내메뉴얼, 출입국/체류안내, 출입국관련 법령지침정보.

sources.title: 출입국/체류안내 main (immigration/stay guide)
sources.evidence: Under 외국인의 체류 lists: 체류일반, 외국인등록, 체류기간 연장, 체류자격변경, 체류자격외활동, 근무처변경/추가, 체류자격부여, 재입국허가(복수), 각종신고의무.

sources.title: 체류일반 (stay general)
sources.evidence: Stay classified into short-term/long-term/permanent residence. Long-term and permanent residence require foreigner registration or domestic residence report within 90 days of entry. Stay within scope of status and permitted period. Employment requires an employment-permitting status. Employment-capable statuses listed: C-4, E-1, E-2, E-3, E-4, E-5, E-6, E-7, E-9, E-10, F-2, F-4, F-5, F-6, H-1.

sources.title: 외국인등록 (foreigner registration)
sources.evidence: Applies to foreigners intending to stay >90 days from entry; also those who lost Korean nationality or were born in Korea and receive >90-day status. Exemptions: A-1/A-2/A-3 and families, certain specially exempted foreigners, certain Canadian nationals <6 months in D-1/D-6/F-1/F-3/G-1, registered foreigners under 17. Timing: within 90 days from entry; immediately when status granted/changed. Procedure diagram: application, passport, one color photo, status-specific documents, fee.

sources.title: 체류기간연장 (extension of stay)
sources.evidence: Extension required to stay beyond permitted period. Application window: from 4 months before expiry until expiry date. Applying after expiry can incur penalty under Immigration Act Article 25. Applied by person or representative at competent office; some statuses such as F-6 may not allow representation. Applicant must be in Korea on application date. Status-specific documents to be checked via status-specific document table/manual.

sources.title: 체류자격변경 (change of status)
sources.evidence: Change of stay status: stop current-status activity, engage in another status's activity. Basic principle: depart, obtain relevant visa, re-enter. Domestic change allowed only restrictively after strict review. Apply before engaging in new-status activity. A-1/A-2/A-3 holders changing due to status change must apply within 30 days.

sources.title: 체류자격외활동 (activity outside status)
sources.evidence: Engaging in another activity while keeping current status requires advance permission. If the other activity is effectively the main/full-time activity, outside-status permission is not allowed (departure + new visa or change of status). Short-term holders (<=90 days) cannot. Permission may be restricted if other workplace has longer hours/higher pay or unstable stay conditions. D-2 and D-4-1 may have fee exemptions in procedure diagram.

sources.title: 근무처변경/추가 (workplace change/addition)
sources.evidence: Applies to employment-permitting statuses adding/changing workplace. Prior-permission targets: C-4, E-9, E-10, H-1, E-6-2, and certain E-7 occupations. Report-after targets: E-1, E-2, E-3, E-4, E-5, most E-6 except E-6-2, and E-7 except prior-permission categories. Handle permission/report before change where applicable. Some institution-name changes are foreigner-registration-information change reports instead.
sources.caution: E-7 occupation-specific prior-permission handling is high-risk; do not generalize without exact occupation/sub-code handling.

sources.title: 체류자격부여 (grant of status)
sources.evidence: For foreigners who lost Korean nationality, were born in Korea, or otherwise stay without status. Domestic birth: apply within 90 days. Loss of nationality/other: within 60 days. If leaving within 60 days (or 90 for birth), grant may not be required. Examples: registered foreigner's Korean-born child → F-3; F-5 holder's minor child → F-5; certain F-2 holder's Korean-born child → F-1; Korean-born child of D-3/E-9/E-10/H-2 holder → F-1.

sources.title: 재입국허가 (re-entry permit)
sources.evidence: Registered foreigners in A-1 to A-3, D-1 to F-3, and F-6 to H-2 may be exempt from re-entry permit if re-entering within one year from departure. F-5 holders exempt within two years. F-4 may re-enter within stay period. Multiple re-entry permit documents: passport, foreigner registration card, integrated application form. Fee 50,000 KRW, some exemptions.
use: travel/re-entry AI answer grounding source map

sources.title: 각종신고의무 (various reporting duties)
sources.evidence: Registered foreigners must report foreigner-registration-information changes within 15 days. Reasons: name/gender/DOB/nationality; passport number/issue date/validity; organization changes for D-1/D-2/D-4/D-5/D-6/D-7/D-8/D-9; H-2 employment-related changes; occupation/annual-income changes for D-7~D-9, E-1~E-10, F-2, F-4, F-6, H-2. Documents: passport, foreigner registration card, report form, evidence of change, student-status report form, occupation/annual-income report form.

sources.title: Korea Visa Portal main + entry-purpose visa guide
sources.evidence: Official Korea Visa Portal. Quick services: e-visa application, e-form visa application, visa issuance certificate application, visit employment pre-application, application status, visit employment lottery confirmation. Entry-purpose visa guide enumerates a detailed sub-code catalog (B-1/B-2-1/B-2-2; C-3-1..C-3-9; C-1/D-5/D-6; F-1/F-2/F-3 sub-codes; G-1-10; D-8 series; F-5-5; F-6-1/F-6-2; D-2-1..D-2-6; D-4-1/D-4-3/D-4-7; D-9 series; D-1; D-3 series; C-4; D-10-1/D-10-2; E-1/E-2/E-3/E-4/E-5; E-6-1..E-6-3; E-7-1/E-7-91; F-5-11; F-4 series; E-9 series; E-10 series; F-1 series; D-7 series; H-2-1/H-2-2/H-2-5/H-2-7; A-1/A-2).
do_not_use_for: authority for in-country extension/registration/change documents unless a specific Visa Portal page explicitly covers those procedure details
